text:
Zara: heads-up — planning a controlled soft-unpin test for runtime/3.8 with models tagged `doc-long`. goal: avoid the sharp perf cliff when deploybot hard-pins on sdk/runtime signature mismatch. targeting low-traffic window 01:30-03:30 UTC. cc @Nikhil @oncall

deploybot: Observed signature mismatch (sdk=3.6 -> runtime=3.8). Default: hard-pin queued (id=pin-4411223344).

Nikhil: +1 to soft-unpin. propose soft flow: 1) mark 0.5% traffic with X-Compat:soft header, 2) SDK returns `compat_score` and `kv_probe` (simulated), 3) if compat_score >= 0.82 and kv_probe ok route to 3.8, otherwise route to regional_variant, 4) create hard pin only if error_rate > 1.5% OR token_mismatch > 0.7% for 12m.

oncall: add deadman=20m and pager if error_rate >1% for 5m. rollback command: `deployctl pin --runtime=3.6 --reason='soft-unpin-fail-4411223344'` — use that as ops escape hatch.

sdk-bot: PR opened for handshake: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/1724 — adds compat_score and kv_probe flag. feature-flagged.

Zara: deploybot config snippet for the test (pushed as freeform string in canary body):
```
soft_unpin: true
percent: 0.5
compat_threshold: 0.82
kv_probe_required: true
deadman_minutes: 20
```

deploybot: Canary scheduled -> soft-unpin-4411223344, eu-west 0.5% at 01:45 UTC. logs: https://ci.redwood/runs/soft-unpin-4411223344

Nikhil: ensure deploybot emits `soft_unpin.event` with canary id, compat_score, kv_probe result, and canary_step so SRE can correlate. also include canary_id in all logs.

oncall: i'll wire dashboards: p95, error_rate, token_mismatch, kv_probe_fail_rate. if any threshold breached run rollback command and ping @eng-releases and @support.

release-docs: will add a release-note checklist item and the rollback command in a small PR: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/1109

Zara: launching canary in 10. i'll post a short status update in 20m. if green for 90m we'll lift the immediate-pin policy for runtime/3.8 in eu-west and plan a 5% ramp over 4h.
